name: What is the process for structural wall framing after the foundation is complete?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for structural wall framing after the foundation is complete?

acceptedAnswer.text: Once the foundation is cured and inspected, the framing process begins. First, the sill plates are secured to the foundation. Then, floor joists and subflooring are installed. Next, wall sections are assembled horizontally on the subfloor and then lifted into place, plumbed, and braced. This involves installing studs, top and bottom plates, headers for windows and doors, and sheathing. Finally, roof trusses or rafters are set. Each step involves careful adherence to blueprints and local building codes.
acceptedAnswer.description: After the foundation, sill plates are installed, followed by floor framing. Wall sections are then built, raised, and braced, with headers and sheathing, concluding with roof framing.
